question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)

Option 1) LKP

Option 2) QRU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26e5cc789a4de40d064ddd3861c5c771ddcb7d4eeac6c3a31c029c691c24791b.png] 

Option 3) EFI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d8381a5b2b168e7e4a17af08a02ea639b0516d83fdade1d8e68a5c03d4126e9.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc1e701fabd1caf0767f1cf078c424b3bdcf334a93eec0ccb332b50edd49871c.png]
